profile.name: Aarav Sharma
profile.tagline: Full Stack Developer · Problem Solver · MERN & Java
profile.intro: I'm a software engineer who loves crafting elegant, performant web experiences end-to-end — from pixel-perfect interfaces to resilient backends. I care about clean architecture, accessibility, and shipping products that feel effortless.
profile.careerObjective: To leverage my full-stack expertise and problem-solving mindset to build impactful, scalable software at a product-driven company where engineering excellence meets real-world value.

projects.title: TradeVerse
projects.description: A real-time stock trading simulator with live market data, interactive charts, paper trading portfolios, and AI-assisted market insights.

projects.title: Meetly
projects.description: A peer-to-peer video conferencing platform with screen sharing, in-call chat, scheduling, and JWT-secured rooms for up to 50 participants.

projects.title: AI Chat Application
projects.description: A context-aware conversational assistant with streaming responses, markdown rendering, session memory, and multi-model routing.

projects.title: Version Control System
projects.description: A lightweight Git-like VCS implemented from scratch in Java, supporting commits, branches, merging, diffs, and a CLI interface.

responsibilities: Built reusable React component library adopted across 4 product teams, cutting feature delivery time by 30%.
Designed REST APIs in Node.js serving 50k+ daily requests with 99.9% uptime.
Optimized MongoDB queries and introduced Redis caching, reducing p95 latency by 45%.
Owned end-to-end features from spec to deployment in an Agile, CI/CD-driven workflow.
Developed client-facing dashboards in React with real-time analytics and role-based access.
Integrated third-party payment and email services; wrote integration tests for critical flows.
Collaborated with design to ship a design system that improved cross-product consistency.

education.details: Coursework: Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, DBMS, Computer Networks, Software Engineering.
